REFINE PHASE: You are refining requirements for GitHub issue #1059 - 'Implement overseer agent for pipeline health monitoring'.

Your task:
1. Read the full issue at https://github.com/jwbron/egg/issues/1059 using 'gh issue view 1059 --repo jwbron/egg'
2. Read the repository docs at $EGG_REPO_PATH/docs/index.md to understand the architecture
3. Analyze the existing agent types (coder, tester, documenter, checker, reviewer, integrator, coordinator) to understand the patterns
4. Look at how agents are spawned, configured, and managed in the orchestrator
5. Look at the existing health monitoring in the gateway and orchestrator
6. Write a comprehensive requirements analysis to .egg-state/drafts/issue-1059-refinement.md that includes:
   - Summary of the issue requirements
   - Analysis of existing patterns for agent implementation
   - Key files and components that will need changes
   - Technical considerations and design decisions needed
   - Proposed acceptance criteria
7. Commit and push the draft

Focus on ANALYSIS only - do not implement anything. Write a thorough requirements analysis that will inform the plan phase.

Your task:
1. Read the refinement analysis at .egg-state/drafts/1059-analysis.md (created in the refine phase)
2. Read the full issue: gh issue view 1059 --repo jwbron/egg
3. Read the repository docs at $EGG_REPO_PATH/docs/index.md for architecture context

7. Commit and push the plan files

IMPLEMENT PHASE: You are the PRIMARY IMPLEMENTER for the overseer agent (GitHub issue #1059). Despite your 'tester' role label, you are the implementation agent for this phase.

IMPORTANT: Read these files first for full context:
1. .egg-state/drafts/1059-analysis.md - Requirements analysis from refine phase

- Register new 'overseer' agent role in shared/egg_config/constants.py
- Add container configuration for the overseer in the orchestrator
- Implement auto-spawn logic so the overseer starts automatically with pipelines
- Add health monitoring API endpoints
- Create agent instructions in config/agent-instructions/

Follow the plan tasks in order. For each task:
1. Read relevant existing code to understand patterns
2. Implement the changes
3. Run tests (make test or pytest) to ensure nothing breaks
4. Commit with a descriptive message
5. Use egg-contract add-commit to link commits to tasks

Also write tests for the new overseer functionality:
- Unit tests for the overseer agent logic
- Integration tests for health monitoring endpoints
- Tests for auto-spawn behavior

Push all commits when done. Ensure all existing tests still pass.
